chapter: Building the band: Dave Duncan, Denver and Rene Hall
title: Quitting the electric shop to go to Denver
summary: Fields tells his bosses he may not return and the band agrees to go to Denver.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And so we were going pretty good and we still hadn't done this battle of the bands yet and so then after Dorsey and that date was coming by, that was my first time then of saying to my bosses, at the electric shop, I don't know if I'm going back to work. So they said, all we can say is we wish you luck and if you want to come back you've got your job.
So I talked to the guys and they said well if you're quitting your job to go, we'll sure go.
Yes--no, no, I wasn't married yet. I was still single then. So I went onto Denver--
You went to Denver; now Dorsey was bringing you out there for the battle of the bands?
Yeah, for the battle of the bands. I had one or two little gigs, but the main one was to play at the battle of the bands.
